purpose: User-requested single-resolution long-duration puncture survival pilot; not a convergence or robust-stability claim.
method: Continue the completed t=10 genuine two-ended wormhole trajectory with identical frozen source and libraries; unchanged full-domain scheme.

assessment.survival: Integrator reaches t=500 without native failure; report finite/positive state and boundary residuals.
assessment.accuracy: Report full-domain radial RMS and unweighted constraint histories, growth from t=10, lapse profiles and invariant mass. Original fine-grid accuracy gates are not reinterpreted as coarse-grid stability gates.
assessment.limitations: Single resolution; no convergence certification, horizon masking, excision, lapse floor, or parameter tuning. Preserve failure if target not reached.

paused_controls: Do not resume the paused quarter-step or historical evolutions.
